title: odw2json document class recipe
description: One YAML file per document class. Patterns are Python regexes matched on folded text (lower case, no diacritics: write 'odwolujacy', not 'Odwołujący'). Lines are matched with re.MULTILINE.

class.description: Class name = output schema name in schemas/<class>.json unless output_schema is given.

output_schema.description: JSON skeleton file (relative to the recipe file, or to the repo root). Default: schemas/<class>.json.

margin.description: Required lead over the runner-up recipe.

required.description: All must match, otherwise this class scores 0.

forbidden.description: Any match sets this class's score to 0.

end.description: Section ends before the first match after start; default = end of document.

within.description: Name of an enclosing section to search in.

head.description: Only the first N chars of the whitespace-collapsed text.

squash.description: Match with all whitespace removed from text and pattern (letter-spaced headings, OCR without spaces).

path.description: Dotted JSON path, relative to the enclosing list item for nested fields.

start.description: Each match starts a new block (list item).

end.description: Optional end of the whole list area.

merge.description: Merge the items index-wise into the list already at this path (extra items join the last one) instead of replacing it.

min_blocks.description: Fewer block starts than this: one item over the whole scope (default: off, no starts = empty list).

pattern.description: regex: named group 'v' (or group 1) is the value.

all.description: regex: every match becomes a list item (field inside a list).

labels.description: after_label: label regexes; a space matches optional whitespace.

value.description: after_label: regex the value must contain (named group 'v' or the whole match is the value); const/derived: the value to set.

max_lines.description: after_label: continuation lines aligned with the value.

below.description: after_label: also look in the line below in the same column (default true).

exclude.description: segments: skip a column segment whose text (leading dots removed) starts with one of these regexes.

not_after.description: segments: skip a value when one of these regexes ends right before it in its segment (e.g. a title such as 'adw.').

raw.description: segments: match 'value', regex: match 'pattern', case-sensitively on the original text (diacritics kept).

nth.description: regex: use only the n-th distinct match (0 first, -1 last).

section.description: any strategy: search only inside this named section (a section of the recipe), whatever the field's own scope.

dictionary.description: lookup: dictionaries/<name>.yaml with entries {id, label, triggers}; triggers are regular expressions (a space matches optional whitespace), so escape literal punctuation.

return.description: lookup: entry key to return (id, label, ...).

if_set.description: derived: sibling path; value when it is non-null, else 'else'.
